decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory that complements the core trailer range, with little reason to withdraw it and minimal resources freed by dropping it.
Box trailers are a core product line with several models that the firm has promoted on its home page, so its investment and public commitment favor continuing.
The car transporter line involves real development and tooling investment and fits the professional-user segment, so any weak results would likely be attributed to temporary market conditions.
The low-bed series is a multi-model line featured on the home page and central to the firm's range, so dropping it is unlikely.
High-cover trailers are a visibly promoted multi-model line tied to the core business, so persistence is expected.
Although it overlaps with box line B, it was prominently featured and is part of the announced range, so the firm is more likely to consolidate it than drop it.
